newsitem.title: USA: Immunomedics launches LeukoScan in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Immunomedics launches LeukoScan in Europe.

text.p: Immunomedics Inc said Tuesday it had launched LeukoScan, its radiolabeled monoclonal antibody fragment for the detection of infectious disease, in Germany and Austria.
LeukoScan is scheduled to launch in the U.K. and Ireland later this week.
The company said that initially, distribution of the product within the European Union will be handled by Mallinckrodt Medical BV, an affiliate of Mallinckrodt Group Inc.

LeukoScan, which provides a one-step, rapid method of locating sites of infection within the body, received final clearance from the European Commission in February for sale and marketing in the 15 nations comprising the European Union.
The company said it expects to begin promoting LeukoScan in the other European countries in the months ahead.
